title: Basic Calculator
body:
Evaluate an expression containing non-negative integers, +, -, parentheses and spaces. A - can also be a unary minus, as in -(2+3) or -5. Do not use eval.

Function to complete

Complete calculate(s). It returns the value of the expression.

Input reading and printing are handled for you, like on LeetCode. The input format below is what the tests and Custom input use.
cons: The result and every intermediate value fit in a signed 64-bit integer

py.pre:
from typing import *
import sys, math, collections, heapq, bisect, itertools, functools
from collections import *
